bibliographic.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Reinforced Self-Check for LLM Hallucination

relevance_to_mlgg: Multi-agent architecture (Solver/Proposer/Checker) with deliberate information asymmetry. 8B model matches proprietary systems. Architecture pattern applicable to MLGG extraction verification.
key_findings: 8B parameter model achieves performance comparable to proprietary systems
Claim decomposition enables granular hallucination detection
Multi-agent RL training improves detection over time
actionable_for_mlgg: Decompose extraction results into verifiable claims (e.g., 'AUROC = 0.85 on test set')
Use separate verification agent to check claims against paper text
Information asymmetry: verifier sees only paper text, not extraction prompt
